text:
maya_cs: quick check-in with @customer-poc-sunn — getting ready for private/VPC go-live next week. top blockers from our side: audit log delivery, KMS key access, IAM cross-account role, and egress firewall rules. can ops team confirm status?
liam_se: network: customer added the SG but traffic to our ingress LB still drops. told them to allow our egress IPs (54.23.11.5/32, 54.23.12.0/24) and open outbound 443/443 TLS. they said they'll push change in staging now.
customer-poc-sunn: pushed ACL change to staging. running curl tests to our health endpoint now, seeing 502 earlier. will post results in 5.
ops-bot: deploy-checker: staging connectivity test 1/3 — failed (502). see log: `curl -v https://private-ingress.redwood.svc/health` -> TLS handshake timed out.
liam_se: ok 502/TLS handshake usually means firewall or SNI mismatch. @customer-poc-sunn can you share VPC NAT gateway route table and any proxy in front?
maya_cs: also KMS — rachel mentioned key policy needs explicit cross-account statement so our service role can Decrypt for telemetry ingestion. that's blocking audit log delivery to their Splunk HEC.
rachel_security: KMS note: key policy must include the Redwood service principal and the customer's logging role. sample snippet to share with them:```
{ "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-ingest"}, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "*" }
```
rachel_security: also asking they DO NOT set a Deny that blocks encryption context we use. we'll send a short doc.
devops_tom: IAM side: prefer cross-account role with least-privilege. trust policy example:```
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-ingest"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}] }
```
devops_tom: role permissions: CloudWatchLogs:PutLogEvents, S3:PutObject (if using S3), kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt limited to the specific key ARN.
customer-poc-sunn: re: audit logs, we'd like Splunk HEC (TLS) -> what's the port and IPs to open? our infra team needs exacts.
maya_cs: Splunk HEC uses 8088 by default or 6514 for TLS syslog. tell them to open 8088/TCP from our egress IPs; if they're using TLS syslog, open 6514. we'll provide the final list of IPs in a separate msg.
liam_se: I ran a packet capture on staging — SYNs from our LB reach their NAT, but the SYN-ACK is dropped before TLS handshake. suggests stateful firewall or proxy dropping. ask them to check connection tracking and any SSL inspection boxes.
maya_cs: enablement check: we still owe a 30-min walkthrough of the observability console and alert wiring. scheduled tentative Wed 10:30 PT. is that ok for everyone?
customer-poc-sunn: Wed 10:30 PT works. can you also cover token rotation and KMS key rollover plan? that's a hard ask from our security reviewers.
rachel_security: yes we'll cover key rotation and key policy ACLs. also request for audit trail: they want immutable retention — recommend sending to a dedicated S3 bucket with object lock + then forwarding to Splunk.
maya_cs: flagged as moderate renewal risk: they've expressed concern about initial cost spikes and missing logs. if we don't stabilise ingestion by end of onboarding window, the renewal owner should be notified.
devops_tom: temporary mitigation: enable prefix caching on their prefix to reduce duplicate token costs and recommend model quantization and batching suggestions to PS.
maya_cs: action items I captured: 1) @customer-poc-sunn share NAT route table & any SSL inspection boxes (due EOD) 2) @rachel_security send KMS key policy example doc (due tomorrow) 3) @liam_se validate egress IP list and confirm ports (due EOD) 4) @devops_tom share cross-account role & minimal policy (done) 5) schedule Wed 10:30 PT walkthrough (maya to send invite). anyone want to add?
liam_se: I'll also run a quick packet trace after their next ACL push and post results here.
customer-poc-sunn: thanks team — will push NAT/ACL updates now and follow up when tests complete. very appreciative of the walkthrough. :pray:
maya_cs: thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when your item is updated. I'll update the onboarding risk board after the walkthrough.
